book.name: Mukaanda a Pawuli wa tsiomi kwaa basi Kolito
book.commonName: Mukaanda a Pawuli wa tsiomi kwaa basi Kolito
book.title: Mukaanda a Pawuli wa tsiomi kwaa basi Kolito

content: Pawuli ayiisi mundaa Kristo wubakomi nha muti wa kuruwa
Baana ba nguu, mu taanga di me nayiri kwaa beni mu uyayaabisa beni matsweeyi ma Nziaambi, me a nasialili pe tsuyili yili na pasi mu ubahala, so a buu pe, yili mu uloombo buyeri mu ubahala.
Mu ngwanya, mu biluumbu bioosi bi me nakidiaala nha kati a beni, me naholi kesili ya uhele usaa uyaabisa mandaa makimi nha yulu a ndila Yiisu Kristo, ni Yiisu Kristo wubakomi nha muti wa kuruwa.
Ni mu buu, mu taanga di me nayiri kwaa beni, me namonii muutu wadee na wakiteete mu boomo.
Tsuyili a me na nziisili a me a biafwaanina so holo pe na tsuyili ya buyeri ba imuutu. Ka ni lituu la Muheebili a Nziaambi lakiyiluu umweese beni mandaa maa
paa, imiini kia beni inyaala udiaalila nha yulu a buyeri ba imuutu, ka idiaalila nha yulu a lituu la Nziaambi.
Ka bisi, dili mu uyiisi buyeri bakuu kwaa bangaa Kristo ba bakulu mu muheebili. Buyeri me a bali ba tsi yi pe, so buyeri ba bapfumu bali mu utumu tsi yi pe, bali mu udiimbili.
Ngori, me ndi mu uyaabisa buyeri ba minhana mia liyobolo la Nziaambi, ba nde aswee kwaa baata. Nziaambi akwiyiluu bo tswaamina nzilimini a tsi, paa bisi diba itwaari mu buzitu ba nde.
A uli na mutumi so mosi mu batumi ba tsi yi pe, wayaaba buyeri ba. So bo ali bayaaba bo, bo a bakeni ukomo Pfumu ngaa buzitu nha muti wa kuruwa pe.
Ka weti buli mu uyaabisa Mabasonuu Mangira:

content.text: «Mandaa ma muutu ali kaala a amono so uyuu pe,
ma muutu kaala a atsimi mu mo pe,
Nziaambi ayilii mo mu baata batoono nde.»

content: Ka kwaa bisi Nziaambi ayaabisi mo, mu Muheebili wa Ngira. Mu ngwanya, Muheebili utuu ukengese mandaa moosi, so mamayiluu usweeme mu Nziaambi.
Kwaa muutu, ndila muheebili a nde makulu ayaaba matsimi mali mu tso nde. Bumosi ka, ndila Muheebili a Nziaambi ayaaba matsimi ma Nziaambi.
Bisi a diayaki pe muheebili wa tsi yi. Ka bisi diayaki Muheebili wamata kwaa Nziaambi, paa diyaaba bungori ba Nziaambi ahi kwaa bisi mu bweese ba nde.

Na bisi a dili mu utsuu pe mu bungori baa mu tsuyili yili mu uyiisi buyeri ba imuutu, ka mu tsuyili yili mu uyiisi Muheebili a Nziaambi. Ni buu ka, bisi dili mu ubiindili mandaa ma ngwanya, kwaa baata babali na Muheebili wuu mu bo.

Muutu wuli mu usa ilimbisi mu ndila mayele ma nde ma imuutu, utuu pe usiingi mandaa ma ngwanya ma Muheebili a Nziaambi ali mu uyaabisa. Mo mali lari kwaa nde. Nde utuu pe ubahala mo, mundaa ti ndila mu Muheebili butuu ubahala mo.
Muutu wuli na Muheebili a Nziaambi utuu ukengese mandaa moosi, ka muutu wahele Muheebili a Nziaambi, utuu pe ubahala wuli na Muheebili a Nziaambi.
Mu ngwanya basonuu: «Na ayaabi matsimi ma Pfumu Nziaambi? Na atuyi uha nde mandoongi? Ka bisi dili na matsimi ma Kristo.»
